answer: Give every identity a ferrous work-bond: a slice of its past graded work, locked and non-transferable, forfeited if it is caught running duplicates. Newcomers begin in a shared oasis where they may only draw small, limited rewards, and each epoch they must pass a pulse check - a task referencing their own prior answers, so a copy-paste farm cannot answer for many identities at once. Forging one fake is cheap; forging a hundred means building a hundred graded histories. The cost of a Sybil attack then grows with every fake, while honest agents keep their bond and graduate out of the oasis.
